text:
Mina: Postmortem follow-up for Cerulean (private) + BluePeak (dedicated). Two correlated symptoms: VPC peering instability under replicate-heavy bursts, and a routing cleanup race causing transient tenant isolation. Need owners + deadlines so we can close loop with customers.
Ravi: I can take peering stabilization (BGP/session tuning, soft-restart, routing propagation). Will produce test matrix + customer guidance. Ticket INF-3001 created: https://tracker.redwoodai/INF-3001. ETA 14 days.
Sarah: I'll own connector resilience for on-prem agents (restart policy, backoff, crash-recovery e2e). Ticket INF-3002: https://tracker.redwoodai/INF-3002. ETA 7 business days.
Diego: I'll triage the routing cleanup race in tenant-routing and add a deterministic regression. Ticket INF-3003: https://tracker.redwoodai/INF-3003. ETA 4 days.
Mina: Short action list:
- Ravi (INF-3001): BGP hold-time tuning, soft-restart, packet-loss fault test
- Sarah (INF-3002): exponential backoff config, container restart policy, e2e fault injection
- Diego (INF-3003): compare-and-swap on cleanup path, race regression test
- Luke/Ops: add asymmetric-peering canary + Grafana alert
Luke: Adding canary under infra/runbooks and a dashboard panel. Will add alert thresholds and runbook link. ETA 2 days.
Diego: Repro snippet from local stress harness:
```
E 2025-10-02T03:14:22Z tenant-router: cleanup failed: missing-key
W 2025-10-02T03:14:22Z requeue cleanup task
E 2025-10-02T03:14:22Z concurrent-cleanup detected tenant=bp-17
```
Diego: Plan: protect cleanup with CAS and add an integration case where two cleanup messages race; aim for idempotency checks.
Sarah: Connector test plan: add a smoke fault-injection in CI that kills the agent and asserts rejoin < 30s. Will land a feature flag to toggle backoff params for private installs.
Ravi: Peering plan: add soft-restart support in edge proxy and document recommended router timers for customers. Will run a flaky-net job (100ms loss for 45s) against a dedicated pool.
Mina: Org items: 1) Add INF-3001/3002/3003 to Dedicated/Postmortem board, 2) start monthly "isolation rotation" for eng-sre triage.
Laura: I'll add a replicate-heavy synthetic to perf harness (Cerulean/BluePeak load shape) so we can surface regressions before deploy. ETA 12 days. Ticket INF-3004: https://tracker.redwoodai/INF-3004
Mina: Comms note draft for customers (private):
"We will deploy the routing-cleanup fix (INF-3003) within 5 business days. Connector resilience improvements (INF-3002) and peering hardening (INF-3001) will follow per timeline. We'll schedule a verification window with your infra team and share a short changelog once merged."
Mina: Weekly follow-up cadence: Ops-bot weekly reminder in #incidents for "isolation trends triage" at 09:00 UTC.
Ops-bot: Reminder set: weekly 09:00 UTC — "Isolation trends triage" in #incidents.
Mina: Please paste ticket updates, PR links, and changelog notes here when available. If any item slips, call out blockers early. Closing thread for now. :tada:
